label: No placebo
rationale: This is a single-group device feasibility study in which participants only use the powered neck exoskeleton. The record describes no control arm, sham comparator, or placebo comparator; the only comparator-like procedure is task performance with the device itself.

evidence.quote: After obtaining written consent, participants will perform tasks using the neck exoskeleton.

title: Evaluation of a Structurally Suitable Neck Exoskeleton in Patients With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis

rule.label: No placebo
rule.reason: All recorded arms have recognized non-placebo types and no placebo mention in arms/interventions. Inferred from saved data; sham controls count as no placebo.
